dependencies.basis: FCSC national accounts methodology and the IMF DSBB metadata for UAE national accounts both state that the System of National Accounts 2008 (or 1993 with 2008 amendments) is the framework used for compilation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The process of organizing national accounts takes into account the nature and peculiarity of the country in terms of its statistical system. ... statistical variables at the state level is based on the System of National Accounts, 1993 and its amendments in the 2008 system.

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF for UAE national accounts confirms SNA 2008 as the conceptual framework.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008 is broadly followed as the framework of concepts and definitions for compiling the national accounts.

dependencies.basis: FCSC CPI methodology and IMF DSBB metadata state that the CPI basket and classification follow the UN Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP / COICOP-HBS).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Price data is collected from about 250 major sources distributed across all the emirates in the country, where the data tab was considered according to the classification of individual consumption by purpose, issued by the United Nations COICOP, according to the recommendations of the 1993 System of National Accounts.

dependencies.basis: Central Bank of the UAE Balance of Payments developments publications explicitly state compilation according to BPM6.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Balance of Payments (BOP) is statistical statement that is compiled in line with international recommendations, in particular the Sixth Edition of the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6) of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

dependencies.basis: Ministry of Finance GFS methodology guide states that UAE Government Finance Statistics Reports are prepared according to the IMF Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The United Arab Emirates Government Finance Statistics Reports are prepared according to the Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014 issued by the International Monetary Fund, which is in line with the concepts and terminology used in the System of National Accounts 2008 issued by the United Nations.

dependencies.basis: Same MoF GFS guide explicitly aligns GFS concepts with SNA 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Terms and concepts are used by the Government Finance Statistics Manual (GFSM2014) and the System of National Accounts (SNA2008).

dependencies.basis: IMF DSBB metadata for UAE national accounts states that imports and exports data used in the accounts are taken from the balance of payments compiled by the Central Bank of the UAE.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Imports and exports data are taken from the balance of payments compiled by the Central Bank of the U.A.E. (CBU); the CBU also supplies figures for banks.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT Methodology and Quality Report for Annual National Accounts states the reference framework is the System of National Accounts 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The reference framework for national accounts statistics is the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA2008)

dependencies.basis: GASTAT CPI methodology and quality documentation and related FAQ state adoption of COICOP 2018 for the consumer basket classification and weight structure.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The time series of the consumer price index was reconstructed starting from 2013 using the Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP 2018) and the chain-linked methodology

dependencies.basis: IMF SDDS DQAF metadata for Saudi Arabia balance of payments states that disseminated data conform to BPM6 and are presented in the standard BPM6 format.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The disseminated data confirm broadly to the 6th edition of the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual (BPM6). ... BOP data are classified and presented in line with the BPM6 standard presentation format.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT Labor Market Statistics methodology and quality reports explicitly state that data on workers by economic activity and wages from the labour statistics are used as inputs in estimating national accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data on workers by economic activity and wages are used as inputs in estimating national accounts.

dependencies.basis: Updated GASTAT Labor Market Statistics methodology confirms labour-market data (employed persons by activity and wages) constitute a key input to national accounts outputs.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data on employed persons by economic activity and wages from the Labor Market Statistics Publication and the Register-based Labor Market Statistics Publication constitute a key input to the outputs of national accounts.
